definitions.gloss: made of leather; leather (as a material attribute)
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is manufactured from leather. Used as a modifier before nouns to describe the material of bags, shoes, belts, and other items.

examples.japanese: {革製|かわせい}のかばんを{持|も}っている。
この{革製|かわせい}の{財布|さいふ}は{十年|じゅうねん}{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I've been using this leather wallet for ten years.

examples.japanese: {革製|かわせい}の{靴|くつ}は{手入|てい}れをすれば{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Leather shoes last a long time if you take care of them.

notes:
Composed of {革|かわ} (leather; hide) and {製|せい} (made of; manufactured). The suffix {製|せい} is highly productive and attaches to materials to indicate what something is made from.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革製|かわせい}の{靴|くつ}: leather shoes
- {革製|かわせい}の{財布|さいふ}: leather wallet
- {革製|かわせい}のベルト: leather belt
- {革製|かわせい}のソファー: leather sofa
- {革製|かわせい}の{手袋|てぶくろ}: leather gloves

OTHER {製|せい} COMPOUNDS:
- {木製|もくせい}: made of wood
- {金属製|きんぞくせい}: made of metal
- {紙製|かみせい}: made of paper
- {布製|ぬのせい}: made of cloth
- プラスチック{製|せい}: made of plastic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レザー: leather — the loanword, often used in fashion contexts and brand names
- {本革|ほんがわ}: genuine leather — distinguishes real leather from synthetic
- {合皮|ごうひ}/{合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}: synthetic leather; faux leather — the artificial alternative
